title: Lively Saudi Crunchy Ferment
description: A refreshing, crunchy fermented dish from Saudi Arabia, perfect for the monsoon season. Made with kosher-friendly ingredients and a hint of soda water.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine rice flour and yeast.
Gradually add in water, stirring until a smooth batter forms.
Add grated ginger and lemon juice, and stir until well combined.
Cover the bowl with a cloth and let it rest for 30 minutes.
After resting, add soda water and stir well.
Transfer the mixture to a fermentation container or a large bowl with a wide mouth.
Cover the container with a cloth or plastic wrap and let it ferment at room temperature for 24-48 hours.
After fermentation, sprinkle black pepper and salt to taste.
